item: Street view caps published in the user manual x12 (row 196)
summary: The World map section states the level-of-detail caps from src/osm/view.py (8,000 objects then clusters on a 40x40 grid; 60,000 vertices then points; streets at 0.2 degrees or narrower, least important classes left out whole and named) in all 12 manuals; a test pins the manuals to the constants.
